FACT-3.gloss: Ethinylestradiol is treated as enzyme-inducing in the reasoning
FACT-3.verify_reason: CONTRADICTED by tool evidence ev-14aa51: The label says the enzyme inducers are other drugs and herbal products (phenytoin, carbamazepine, rifampicin, St. John's wort). It describes ethinyl estradiol as a substance whose levels they lower.

FACT-4.verify_reason: CONTRADICTED by tool evidence ev-adb0e0: The drospirenone label says the main metabolites of DRSP are made without the cytochrome P450 system. It also says DRSP did not inhibit CYP2C19 or CYP3A4 in vivo. Tri Femynor does not contain drospirenone.

FACT-11.gloss: The label does not recommend taking Tri Femynor with food
